summary: The narrator is released from a truck after being held and transported blindfolded, stepping out into a gray, drizzling alley and reuniting with Van (Vanessa) and Jolu, who hug him. When he asks where Darryl is, they suggest he may still be in the truck, which then reverses toward them as the narrator shouts for Darryl, and the excerpt ends with Jolu and Vanessa dragging him away as the truck backs into the street.
one_line: The narrator is released from a truck into a city alley, reunites with Van and Jolu, and learns the fate of Darryl remains unresolved.
key_facts: The narrator's wrists were unshackled and his hood removed before he was returned to the truck.
A severe haircut woman returned his phone, devices, wallet and pocket change in a ziploc bag.
The woman extended her hand to the narrator, who just looked at it, and she gave him a wry smile.
The woman mimed zipping up her lips and pointed at the narrator before opening the truck door.
It was daylight outside, gray and drizzling, with an alley leading toward cars, trucks and bikes.
The narrator feared the guards were playing with him and would drag him back inside and put the bag over his head again.
The narrator's sneakers crunched on broken glass, a needle and gravel on the alley floor.
Van (Vanessa) was crying as she hugged the narrator, and he said 'I'm OK' in reply.
Jolu whispered 'You're safe, bro' in the narrator's ear and hugged him even tighter than Vanessa had.
Jolu and Vanessa both looked at each other when the narrator asked where Darryl was.
Jolu suggested Darryl might still be in the truck.
The truck was a nondescript white 18-wheeler, and someone had already brought the folding staircase inside.
The truck's rear lights glowed red as it rolled backwards toward them, emitting a steady eep, eep, eep.
The narrator shouted 'Wait! What about Darryl?' as the truck accelerated toward them.
Jolu and Vanessa each held one of the narrator's arms and dragged him away while he struggled and shouted.
